title: Sandboxed Virtual Desktop Infrastructure for Computer-Use Agents
oneLiner: Cua provides lightweight macOS and Linux virtual machine sandboxes paired with a Python SDK so vision-language agents can safely control full desktop applications via mouse and keyboard.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
